findings.claim_text: The terms treat agent-initiated transactions as the user's own, including those caused by bugs, hallucinations or misinterpretations.
The limit applies to each purchase separately and does not accumulate; a funding link is invalid above $150 or outside USD.
Disclosed agent volume: none from Stripe, Visa, PayPal or OpenAI.
findings.contradicting_quote: hundreds of secure, agent-initiated transactions have been successfully completed in collaboration with partners across the ecosystem
